description: A Node.js script for measuring startup memory (RSS) of openclaw commands across different scenarios, including platform checks, environment setup, and parsing RSS output.

methods.name: formatFixGuidance
methods.description: Generates guidance message for fixing startup memory issues based on test case and details.

methods.name: formatFailure
methods.description: Formats failure message including guidance for troubleshooting.

methods.name: parseMaxRssMb
methods.description: Parses maximum RSS value from stderr output.

methods.name: buildBenchEnv
methods.description: Builds environment variables for benchmarking subprocesses.

methods.name: runCase
methods.description: Runs a test case to measure RSS and checks against limits, throwing errors if limits are exceeded or issues occur.
